reviews.title: Great basic motherboard!
reviews.comment: Very basic motherboard, but I built a office PC and decided to go with this motherboard. So far I'm not disappointed. Installation is very easy and simple. Highly recommended for those looking to build a basic everyday computer.
reviews.author: Kindle Customer

reviews.title: Bad Motherboard I believe!!
reviews.comment: Having problems with audio, if I re start the pc I get no Audio!! Shutting down completely and turning back on then I get audio! I tried clearing the CMOS, uninstalling the audio software and reinstalling, updating and reversing the update on the drivers, and resetting the sound! Still not fixed! I think it’s a defective Motherboard! Very angry MSI!!!!
reviews.author: Intriging
